meta.name: Last Meals
meta.description: What would your last meal be? Join Mythical Chef Josh and celebrity guests as they dig into their ultimate last meal, sharing surprising tastes, personal memories, and culinary stories.

videos.title: Brennan Lee Mulligan Eats His Last Meal (The Director's Cut)
videos.overview: Brennan’s Last Meal is one of the longest episodes we’ve ever released and that’s after we cut out nearly an hour of conversation. Y’all have been asking to see the full, unedited version, so today we’re happy to present Brennan Lee Mulligan: Uncut.
